q: Which design flew furthest on average?
Identify the anomaly for the dart and calculate its mean without it.
2.0 m (maybe it hit something). Mean of the other four = 24.3 / 4 = about 6.1 m.
Calculate the range for the dart (without the anomaly) and compare its reliability with the stunt plane.
6.4 − 5.8 = 0.6 m. The stunt plane’s range is 4.3 m, so the dart is much more consistent.
Explain why the glider flies further, using the forces on it.
Its wide wings give more lift, so it falls more slowly and the forward motion lasts longer before weight brings it down; drag is still low.
